50520970.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CBX1 chromodomain (unknown origin) by ITC method

original_paragraph.ITC Experiments: All ITC measurements were recorded at 25 °C with an AutoITC200 microcalorimeter (MicroCal Inc., MA). All protein and compound stock samples were in the target buffer (25 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8, 150 mM NaCl, and 2 mM β-mercaptoethanol), and then diluted in the same buffer to achieve the desired concentrations: 100 μM protein and 1.0 mM compound. The concentration of the protein stock solution was established using the Edelhoch method, whereas compound stock solutions were prepared based on mass. A typical experiment included a single 0.2 μl compound injection into a 200 μl cell filled with protein, followed by 26 subsequent 1.5 μl injections of compound. Injections were performed with a spacing of 180 seconds and a reference power of 8 μcal/sec. Control experiments were performed titrating each compound into buffer under identical conditions to determine the heat signals, if any, that arise from diluting the compound. If applicable, the heats of dilution generated were then subtracted from the protein-compound binding curves. The initial data point was routinely deleted. The titration data was analyzed using Origin Software (MicroCal Inc., USA) by non-linear least squares, fitting the heats of binding as a function of the compound:protein ratio to a one site binding model.

50520808.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CBX5 chromodomain (unknown origin) by ITC method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C. The CBX5 chromodomain (100 μM) was loaded into the sample cell, and the ligand (1000 μM) was loaded into the syringe. The buffer used was 20 mM Tris, pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% Tween-20. The experiment consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (MicroCal) with a one-site binding model. The binding affinity (Kd) was calculated from the fit of the data. The experiment was performed in triplicate, and the mean Kd value was reported. The control experiment involved titrating the ligand into buffer alone to account for any heat of dilution.

assay_conditions.control_method: Titration of ligand into buffer alone to account for any heat of dilution
